faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHM Assam Medical Officer (MBBS) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the NHM Assam Medical Officer (MBBS) posts is 22nd September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer (MBBS) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 78 vacancies for the Medical Officer (MBBS) position announced by NHM Assam.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree from a recognized Medical College and be registered with the Medical Council of India (MCI) or Assam Medical Council (AMC). A minimum of 1 year of experience is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer (MBBS) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Medical Officer (MBBS) post is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer (MBBS) position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 55,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NHM Assam Medical Officer (MBBS) recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer (MBBS) posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview or selection test.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment for Medical Officer (MBBS) posts in NHM Assam is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the online application link in the 'Important Links' section of this article, or by visiting the official NHM Assam website.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of NHM Assam?
faq.answer: The official website of the National Health Mission, Assam is nhm.assam.gov.in.
